Jorge — appreciate the forecast and clear ask. High level we typically present three approaches (each can be tailored to your ramp):

1) Standard ladder (marginal pricing): tokens billed per-breakpoint buckets — you pay the marginal price for tokens in each bucket. Good when you want upside at scale but have step changes.
2) Blended commit rate (single effective per-token): we compute a single blended cents/token on your committed volume (simpler for finance, smoother month-to-month).
3) Smoothed ladder (hybrid): ladder breakpoints but with a "smoothing pool" and quarterly true-up so spikes are softened — reduces month-to-month billing jumps while preserving marginal incentives.

Quick example (illustrative): breakpoints at 0-100M, 100M-300M, >300M with marginal rates $0.0006 / $0.0005 / $0.0004 respectively. For your ramp we can show both the marginal bill by month and a blended effective token price across year.

I've attached a short rate card and a smoothing-playbook PDF with the mechanics. If you want I can run the exact numbers from your spreadsheet and send a one-page summary (marginal monthly bill + blended effective rate + proposed smoothing credit).

Are you available for a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through choices? Proposed times: 10:00-10:30 PT or 14:00-14:30 PT.

Hi Jorge — thanks for the forecast. I ran a worked example (numbers below) to show marginal vs blended outcomes and a suggested smoothing mechanism.

Assumed ladder (illustrative):
- 0–100M tokens/month: $0.00060 per token
- 100M–300M tokens/month: $0.00050 per token
- >300M tokens/month: $0.00040 per token

Your monthly ramp (tokens/month): M1 50M, M2 100M, M3 150M, M4 200M, M5 300M, M6+ 400M (we used M6–M12 = 400M each).

Marginal billing (month by month rough):
- M1 (50M): 50M * 0.00060 = $30,000
- M2 (100M): 100M * 0.00060 = $60,000
- M3 (150M): (100M * 0.00060) + (50M * 0.00050) = $85,000
- M4 (200M): (100M * 0.00060) + (100M * 0.00050) = $110,000
- M5 (300M): (100M * 0.00060) + (200M * 0.00050) = $160,000
- M6–M12 (400M): (100M * 0.00060) + (200M * 0.00050) + (100M * 0.00040) = $200,000 per month

Annualized total under marginal billing (sum M1–M12) = $1,400,000 (illustrative).

Blended effective rate (single per-token):
- Total tokens year = 50 + 100 + 150 + 200 + 300 + (400 * 7) = 4,000M tokens (i.e., 4,000,000,000 tokens).
- Effective blended unit price = Annual spend / Total tokens = $1,400,000 / 4,000M = $0.00035 per token (note: illustrative — rounding applied).

Observation: with these ladder prices the blended effective rate looks favorable because extended months at 400M push average down. However month-to-month marginal billing jumps (e.g., M5->M6) are visible.

Suggested smoothing (hybrid) approach we often offer:
- Commit is structured as ladder but customer gets a monthly "smoothing allowance" equal to 15% of committed volume that can be used to absorb breakpoint jumps.
- Quarterly true-up: at quarter end we reconcile usage vs committed and apply (a) carry-forward credits for under-utilization up to 20% of quarter volume, (b) a true-up charge for over-utilization at marginal rates.
- Effective protection: this keeps month-to-month invoices within a defined band while preserving marginal incentives across tiers.

Next steps I recommend:
1) We run the same calc on the exact XLS you sent and produce a 1-page summary showing: marginal bill by month, blended effective price, and proposed monthly invoice under smoothing.
2) Draft contract language for smoothing and carry-forward caps (Marissa will draft).
3) Schedule the 30-min sync — Logan / Marissa please pick a slot.

Happy to hop on the call and walk through the spreadsheet line-by-line.
